content_sections.heading: CURaj Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Catalytic Upcycling of Plastic Waste Using Oxidized Charcoal-Stabilized Metal-Chalcogenide Nanocomposites
Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Govt. of India, under the Inclusivity Research Grant scheme
01 Year (extendable to additional 2 years or till the end date of the project, subject to satisfactory performance)
₹37,000 per month for first two years and ₹42,000 per month for third year plus HRA as applicable
Central University of Rajasthan (CURaj), Rajasthan, India

content_sections.heading: About CURaj
content_sections.text: Central University of Rajasthan is located at Banadarsindri, Ajmer, Rajasthan. This post sits in the Department of Chemistry, School of Chemical Sciences and Pharmacy. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Partha Roy of the Department of Chemistry.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualifications printed in the notice: Knowledge of material science, nanocatalysts, metal-ligand reaction mechanisms. Experience in analytical techniques such as NMR, SEM, XRD etc. will be advantage. Good analytical and communication skills. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. Degree in Chemistry/Material Science/Nanotechnology or equivalent degree graduates from reputed University/Institute with minimum 55% or equivalent CGPA; GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month for the first two years and ₹42,000 per month for the third year, plus HRA as applicable. The engagement is on contract basis for 01 Year, extendable to an additional 2 years or till the end date of the project, subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: CURaj Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The scope of work printed in the notice is: Synthesis and characterization of metal–chalcogenide nanomaterials using advanced techniques, e.g. SEM, TEM, NMR, Powder XRD, XPS etc. Utilize these nanomaterials for plastic waste upcycling.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CURaj Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and your educational certificates (10th class onwards). Email them to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Partha Roy, at [email protected] . Send the email on or before 13 December 2026. The notice does not describe any online form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates are entitled for the interview. The date of the interview will be notified separately. The interviews will be held in the Department of Chemistry, Central University of Rajasthan Campus. Original mark sheets and relevant certificates of educational qualification of the selected candidate will be verified prior to offering the position.

rows.event: Last date to send CV and certificates by email

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given to the candidate participating in the interview. If the appointment letter is offered, the selected candidate must join in-person at Central University of Rajasthan for the fellowship to be effective. The post is on contract basis; extension is subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the CURaj JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is an M.Sc. Degree in Chemistry/Material Science/Nanotechnology or equivalent degree with minimum 55% or equivalent CGPA, along with GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET.
